profile.headline: Software Engineer at CoStar Group| Howard Alum
profile.geoLocationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
profile.summary:
I am a Computer Science professional with solid experience in both education and applying the basics of my knowledge in practical tasks. Technology has led me to achieve third in the prestigious BESmart Hackathon, demonstrating my ability to innovate and solve tricky questions under pressure.

To top it all off, I gained practical experience during my multiple internships at Google, where I was exposed to the latest technology infrastructures and took part in projects that have assisted me in learning and improving my tech and cooperative skills. Along with my formal jobs, I have been exploring my interest in game development, designing and building games that represent or highlight my skills and technical expertise alongside dabbling in Machine Learning Models and AI.

With a robust foundation in theoretical and practical aspects of computer science. As a result, I am excited about taking on a new full-time position that will allow me to keep developing and contributing to the world of technology.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed a .NET application to track property report statuses, improving management efficiency.
Utilized AWS DynamoDB for storing and retrieving user-specific reports, enhancing data accessibility.
Designed and deployed APIs and endpoints for a full-stack web application.
Collaborated with React and Node.js to build scalable full-stack solutions.
positions.insights: Skills: React Native · Amazon Dynamodb · .NET Framework · WebSocket · Problem Solving · Java · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · React.js · Web Engineering · Software Infrastructure

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed an API for seamless interaction between C++ and Python for the third-party framework TensorFlow. Worked closely with advanced AI and Machine learning tools to take gather various structures of data. 
Utilized the TensorFlow library to create data flow graphs for machine learning and artificial intelligence. Constructed presentation for a technical decision for our project that would affect the structure of our project.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · TensorFlow · Machine Learning · Python (Programming Language) · Problem Solving · Java · Computer Science

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Developed an full-stack developer productivity platform for Google’s engineers.
Leveraged the D3 framework to create an interactive graph for a polished user experience.
Improved understanding and debugging of codified data privacy policies as part of the privacy infrastructure team.
Experienced the end-to-end development process, which consisted of writing design documents and implementation plans
Collaborated as a team with one other intern to ensure on time delivery of all milestones
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · C++ · Front-End Development · Python (Programming Language) · Problem Solving · Computer Science

positions.title: Logistics Intern
positions.description:
Created codified tech manuals for various military vehicles and equipment.
Improved various supply chain documents for Logistics team.
Crafted a high-level presentation for senior engineers and customers

positions.title: Project Intern
positions.description:
Engineered a product to verify sufficient working environment for construction workers.
Utilized Auto-desk Rivet to remodel various infrastructure documents
Delegated tasks among a small team of interns to ensure a timely and viable product
